title: Unit Event — Deeper and Deeper — Episode4 Unbridgeable Gulf

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime agrees to participate in a workshop run by ArcLand. As Rui takes the directors' course, he is confronted with something he's never realized about himself before.

rows.Line: ArcLand - Workshop Venue

rows.Speaker: Veteran Director
rows.Line: Our workshop will end here for today.

rows.Speaker: Veteran Director
rows.Line: For those interested, after this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (“Insipid”...)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line:
You seem smart and decently clever.
So, if you maintain your current course, you'll likely manage to do reasonably well for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Producing what's asked of you is talent too, in a way. But... I think you're of a different breed, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Different...

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: That being said, this is all just my personal opinion. Try not to dwell on it too much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Every other time he gave feedback, his comments struck at the core of each presentation...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, I can't simply brush this aside as a matter of “personal opinion”.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The concept of appealing to a wide audience, itself, didn't appear to be the problem.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, does that mean I took the wrong approach in terms of the theme? Or maybe, in going for broad appeal, I sacrificed too much originality...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...? What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't forget about us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Our workshop finished for the day, so we decided to come and get you. You're going, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Going where...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, didn't anyone tell you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Those who wish to are welcome to watch and take notes as the cast of the Center Theatre practices for their next show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Asahi's playing the lead!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I vaguely remember them mentioning something about that just now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I was so lost in thought that I forgot to listen to everything else.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(In order to think things through properly later...
For now, I need to shift my attention.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you all for coming to get me.
So, let's start heading over, shall we?
Center Theatre

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! This theatre's so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is supposed to be one of the best theatres in the country.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd heard that only the best actors ArcLand has to offer are ever allowed to perform here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And the same care and effort seem to have gone into every aspect of this theatre's design.

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line: You'll be standing in a different position for this scene to make sure you're not in the shadow of the background props.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Understood. I'll run it through once and let you all know if things don't feel right.

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line: Of course. Now, about the timing for the lights...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's Asahi.
They're doing a dress rehearsal today, so that's what they must be discussing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it appears that way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He even helped the directors with our workshop today. I'm honestly astonished by his sheer stamina.

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line:
That's it from me.
Do you have any other questions, Asahi?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: No, that's all from me as well.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, would it be okay if I stepped out for a second before we begin rehearsing?

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line:
Of course.
But please refrain from eating while wearing your costume.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Haha. Never!
I was just hoping to talk to some of my friends.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Hey, you guys! Are you all here to watch?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! The workshop hosts invited us over to give us an extra learning opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I see. If possible, I'd like to hear your comments later.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Since this show is special to me in many ways.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Special? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: This show is written and directed by Tom.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's actually still supposed to be a secret. Most of the details regarding this show haven't been released to the public.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's incredible... Congratulations.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Thanks. I kept hoping that we'd cross paths someday, as long as I continued to be an actor...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
But I was staggered when I heard the news.
It just didn't feel real.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I understand what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line: Asahi! We begin rehearsing in five minutes!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Oh, I should get going.
I'll see you all later. And enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be rooting for you from the seats.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Break a leg!
se_walk_men_002_3

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“Geez, this place is covered in spiderwebs.
Creepy old mansion...”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“Well, no matter.
I'll just clean it up, sell it and get it off my hands.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“Hm...?
I thought I saw something cross the hallway just now.”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line:
“Who are you...?
None may set foot in this place without my permission...”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Whoa!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This show is titled “Goodbye Ghosts”.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Asahi is playing the protagonist, Luke.
A lonely young man who lost his family at a very young age.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's kind by nature, but has trouble forming relationships with others. As a result, he struggles to hold down work, and leads a bit of a desperate life.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But one day, Luke suddenly ends up inheriting an old mansion from a distant relative. That is where this story begins...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“Okay, now I understand.
This distant relative of mine, due to being a real weirdo, decided to buy and live in a bona fide haunted mansion.”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: “A weirdo? How rude... He was a good man, and a good housemate to us all.”

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: “Yeah! All of us had a lot of fun together as friends♪”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “How many 'friends' are we talking about here?”

rows.Speaker: Actor C
rows.Line: “If you're talking about us ghosts, then I'd say around a hundred.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “There's no way that a hundred ghosts can fit inside this mansion! Wait, I'm not standing inside anyone right now, am I?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This ghost story isn't very scary at all! It's actually really interesting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and it includes many comical scenes. That means this show should appeal to everyone from children to grown adults.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (All of the ghosts living in this mansion are capricious and fickle. If they don't like the human residents, they'll use any and all means to run them out of the house.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Luke is strapped for cash, and needs to sell this mansion as quickly as possible. But he also knows that he won't earn very much in its current state.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, Luke begins to concoct a plan.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ghosts linger in this world due to unresolved issues. If he can resolve the regrets of every ghost, they'll all vanish from the mansion.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Thus begins the monumental task of going around to every ghost, learning what anchors them to this world, and granting their last requests...)

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: “What do I want to do?”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“Tell me everything that comes to mind.
I'll do what I can to make it all happen.”

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: “Hmm... There's so much...”

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: “But I really wanna go somewhere with my mom and dad while holding their hands.”

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
“Because I was in the hospital for so long.
I wasn't really allowed to leave my bed...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Wanting to see the people they cared about the most one last time. Wanting to apologize to friends who they parted from in anger.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Every ghost's wish is simple but heartfelt.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Some of them seem resentful and malicious at first, but underneath it all...)

rows.Speaker: Actor C
rows.Line:
“Thank you for helping me, Luke.
I feel much better now.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “All I did was bring your old lover to the mansion... Are you sure you're okay with how things went?”

rows.Speaker: Actor C
rows.Line: “I am. I got to scare him by pretending to be an evil spirit, so I'm sure he's over me now.”

rows.Speaker: Actor C
rows.Line:
“I mean, I really am like an evil spirit...
I felt so satisfied when I watched him crying day and night, unable to forget me.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Does that really make you evil?”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “It's only natural to want someone precious to you to remember you after you've gone.”

rows.Speaker: Actor C
rows.Line:
“Yes, I know.
But I love him so much... I'll let him go.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wow, indeed.
Asahi's rendition of Luke is remarkable, of course...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But the ghosts' performances let you vividly picture their past lives, even when the details aren't shown on the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (You can't see the ghosts' expressions due to the masks they're all wearing.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The masks represent the uncrossable line between the living and the departed. And by leaving the audience's minds to fill in their expressions, it makes it easier to empathize with the ghosts.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I understand the technique on an analytical level.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “It's just us left now, huh.”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line:
“Yes...
I'm amazed that you were able to help all the other ghosts.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“Oh, is this wine my reward?
I did think it was an expensive vintage.”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: “No, it was something I had stashed away before my death, and never got a chance to drink...”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: “But now, I can say that I've fulfilled my wish of sharing it with a dear friend. That means I will vanish from this mansion tonight.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The more time lonely Luke spent with the ghosts, the more comfortable he became around them. He had found a place to call home.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And so, each time he saw a friend off, the specter of that loneliness grew a little stronger.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And this is the most important part of the story. The moment he says goodbye to the last one...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Would you laugh if I told you that I feel sad right now?”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line:
“No.
I believe that's the mark of a proper farewell.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“I see...
Yeah. You're right.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “When I was all by myself, I never actually felt lonely.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“But now, I'm all choked up...
My heart aches and I can't seem to stop crying.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“Still, I'm glad we met...
I'm glad this haunted mansion came into my life.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “So, thank you.”

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line:
I enjoy family-oriented stories quite a lot.
They seem simple, but many of them have deep depths too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (As each ghost finds peace, the stage that was initially very lively grows emptier and emptier. A hole begins to grow in each audience member's heart.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But then comes the end... The narrow spotlight illuminating Luke's smile brings everything home.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (People come and people go. This story is the story of life itself.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And even within the most final parting, there is still joy...a blessing. You feel that from the bottom of your heart.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (As a scriptwriter and director, he's miles ahead of me.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It doesn't matter how influenced I am by him, or how much I try to copy him.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The depth of the world he created, the weight of the message he's trying to send, everything...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I still have much to learn...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (How do I close that gap...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have no idea. But...)
